name: Grep
description: Powerful search tool built on ripgrep. Supports regex, glob filtering, and multiple output modes (content, files_with_matches, count).

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: The regex pattern to search for

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: File or directory to search in

parameters.name: output_mode
parameters.description: Output mode: content, files_with_matches, or count
